reuse.why: Uses the existing extractTagsFromText helper inside a small isFixedCostGroup predicate, but does not consolidate the six per-action category queries it has to edit.

duplication.why: The same notes join, group_note column, widened row type and isFixedCostGroup early-return are pasted into all six month-wide actions.

placement.why: The predicate and the edits live in budget/actions.ts with the actions, consistent with where the tree puts these rules.

scope.why: Besides the feature, the diff reformats an unrelated existing test setup block (set budget to last month spending) line by line.

maintainability.why: The tag test is defined once, but the rule is wired per action, so a seventh month-wide action or a change to the data source must be repeated six times.

bypasses_abstraction.where: No existing shared month-action selection exists in this tree to go around; each action already had its own query.

disguised_duplication.where: The repeated join and check in actions.ts are overt copies.

one_place.where: Only the tag test is shared (isFixedCostGroup); the notes join and the decision to apply it are repeated separately in copyPreviousMonth/getBudgetData, setZero, setLastMonthSpending and set3/6/12MonthAvg.
